notes: Deploy the accepted MemecoinCemetery application for Ethereum mainnet. Its implicit nonpayable constructor takes no arguments and needs no initialization. The application is tokenless, fee-free, ownerless and immutable, and rejects ETH transfers and payable calls. Each token can have one wake or permanent grave. A wake lasts 30 days and permits an epitaph of at most 140 bytes. Before the deadline, a caller holding at least 0.1% of the current reported total supply can cancel the wake; re-digging is allowed 30 days after cancellation. Anyone can seal an unopposed wake at or after its deadline. Token reads use try/catch, and reverting reads prevent digging. Release is blocked by missing committed build configuration: foundry.toml is absent and forge config resolves bytecode_hash = "ipfs" and cbor_metadata = true. Reproduced with Foundry 1.8.3 and solc 0.8.26: the default runtime is 5409 bytes with a CBOR trailer; building with bytecode_hash = "none" and cbor_metadata = false produces a different 5355-byte runtime without that trailer. Resolving this requires a separately authorized configuration change committing both required settings in foundry.toml before release and source verification. This manifest cannot configure the compiler; diagnostic environment overrides do not fix the committed tree. Source verification remains a release requirement; this manifest does not attest verification.
